_notes:
ST LIS2DW12 3-axis accelerometer at 0x18 (SA0 low) or 0x19 (SA0 high). 8-bit registers; IF_ADD_INC (CTRL2 bit 2, on at power-up) makes multi-byte reads step through them
Detection: WHO_AM_I (0x0F) = 0x44. At 0x18 it is tried before MPRLS (no detection values) and with MCP9808 (two-register pattern) and MLX90393 (identPriority 1); at 0x19 with MICS6814Pimoroni (ID 0x6AE2 at 0xFA)
Init: CTRL2 (0x21) = 0x40 - soft reset, 5 ms; CTRL2 = 0x0C - block data update, IF_ADD_INC; CTRL6 (0x25) = 0x14 - +/-4 g, low noise, bandwidth ODR/2; CTRL1 (0x20) = 0x54 - 100 Hz, high-performance mode (14-bit), 10 ms. It powers up in power-down (CTRL1 0)
Poll (100 ms): OUT_T (0x0D-0x0E), then OUT_X, OUT_Y, OUT_Z (0x28-0x2D). The axes are 14 bits left-justified in little-endian 16-bit values, so read as 16 bits they are 8192 per g at +/-4 g. Temperature is 12 bits left-justified, 16 per degC with 0 at 25 degC: 16-bit / 256 + 25
Source: registers and sensitivities from the ST LIS2DW12 datasheet (DS11920)

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-11-08, measuring at 0x18): the lone 0x99 write and 1-byte read returns 0x7F; CTRL1-CTRL6 (0x20-0x25) unchanged and measuring carried on
